title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware
description: <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Why Verifone</span></h2> <p>For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. </p> <p>We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors.  </p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy. </p> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">What's Exciting About The Role</span></h2> <p>We are seeking an experienced <strong>Senior Product Manager – Hardware. I</strong>n this role you will be pivotal in translating Verifone’s global hardware strategy into strong regional commercial performance. Sitting at the intersection of Global Hardware Product, Regional Product, Sales, and Customer Success, this role ensures that EMEA markets receive the right solutions, at the right time, with the right positioning </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Hardware Strategy & Catalogue Ownership</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage the EMEA hardware product catalogue — maintaining accuracy across device models, configurations, lifecycle status, and regional availability</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global ↔ Regional Hardware Liaison</strong></p> <ul> <li>Champion EMEA's voice in global hardware strategy — feeding market insights into the roadmap that reflect field intelligence, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics,  briefing stakeholders on updates, and sharing pipeline visibility to keep cross-functional teams aligned. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Regulatory & Payment-Scheme Compliance: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own EMEA's regional certification roadmap (PCI PTS, EMVCo,).Pre-Production & Sample Management </li> <li>Control and distribute pre-production hardware samples within the region, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. </li> <li>Manage NPI (New Product Introduction) readiness activities within the region — ensuring internal teams are prepared ahead of commercial availability. </li> <li>Control and distribute pre-production hardware samples across the region, and manage NPI (New Product Introduction) readiness to ensure internal teams are prepared ahead of commercial availability. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Hardware Lifecycle & EOL Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own EOS/EOL planning for EMEA  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales Enablement & Customer Engagement </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the EMEA hardware demo/evaluation programme (device configuration, refresh, field enablement), support RFPs with technical positioning, and represent Verifone as the hardware SME in customer QBRs, pilot evaluations, and partner engagements with the credibility of a subject matter expert </li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Enablement</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Support the enablement of ISV & Acquirer channels and serve as the point of contact for strategic partner reviews and roadmap briefings. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Competitive  Positioning</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Maintain current competitive hardware positioning for Sales and Product teams, and monitor market signals to identify portfolio enhancements. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Field Quality & Reliability</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Escalation Support </li> </ul> <p><strong>KPIs & Reporting</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Define and maintain the regional hardware scorecard — catalogue accuracy, certification cycle time, NPI readiness, time-to-market on new SKUs, and field reliability KPIs. </li> <li>Deliver a regular hardware operating review to EMEA Product, Sales, and CS leadership; surface risks, dependencies, and decisions needed from the global team. </li> <li>Define and maintain the EMEA hardware scorecard (certification NPI readiness,), and deliver regular operating reviews to Product & Sales leadership.  </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Skills and Experience we desire</span></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or a related technical role within the payments or fintech industry; Senior PM level or equivalent. </li> <li>Hands-on expertise in card-present payment environments — POS hardware, payment terminals, EMV certification, processes. </li> <li>Direct familiarity with payment terminal hardware ecosystems; experience with Verifone or a competing hardware vendor strongly preferred. </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage a product catalogue or portfolio across SKU lifecycle, pricing coordination, and regional availability. </li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to drive outcomes across Product, Sales, Operations, Engineering, and CS without direct authority. </li> <li>Customer-facing credibility: comfortable presenting hardware roadmaps and product positions to enterprise customers, partners, and senior internal stakeholders. </li> <li>Excellent written communication skills; able to produce clear regional POVs, competitive briefs, and executive-level summaries. </li> <li>Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving, matrixed environment. </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Desirable Skills and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li>Deep familiarity with Verifone's hardware portfolio () and software platform (Payment Applications, Gateways). </li> <li>Experience with certification processes for payment devices, including modem qualification and network sunset planning. </li> <li>Background in pre-production hardware evaluation, sample management, or New Product Introduction (NPI) processes. </li> <li>Experience supporting enterprise Sales teams with technical RFP responses, demo programmes, and hardware-level competitive positioning. </li> <li>Prior experience working within a global product organisation with regional go-to-market responsibilities. </li> <li>Familiarity with Android-based payment device platforms, including PSDK, MPoC/SoftPOS, or PCI PTS certification processes.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Our Commitment</span></h2> <p>Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Account Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor and a cornerstone of our commercial team. You'll own an above-average revenue target and be expected to consistently deliver, and exceed, it. Operating with a high degree of autonomy; you'll manage complex, high-value deals end-to-end, drive forecast accuracy, and actively shape how we go to market. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic influence: you'll be as comfortable building a Looker report as you are leading a high-stakes negotiation, and as effective with Finance and Product as you are in front of a customer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of key accounts, consistently exceeding revenue targets and carrying above-average quota.</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline and revenue forecasts, surfacing risks proactively and identifying in-quarter opportunities to accelerate attainment.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations; adapting style to different stakeholders and closing with minimal concessions.</li> <li>Build and tailor compelling value propositions, running multi-channel outreach to fill and advance pipeline efficiently.</li> <li>Manage multiple concurrent work-streams with clear ownership, balancing scope, time, and quality with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions and influence roadmap priorities based on customer feedback.</li> <li>Analyse multi-dimensional data in Looker, AI and Google Sheets to surface actionable insights and build compelling, decision-driving narratives.</li> <li>Coach junior team members and contribute to a culture of proactive, well-received feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in digital advertising, account management, or consultative sales; preferably within mobile or programmatic ad-tech.</li> <li>Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline management skills, with experience running high-value deals from prospecting through close.</li> <li>Skilled negotiator who adapts approach intuitively and is comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</li> <li>Proficient in Looker, AI and Google Sheets, with the ability to analyse complex data sets and build clear, impactful visualisations independently.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional collaborator, with experience engaging Product, Finance, and Marketing beyond immediate deal needs.</li> <li>High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback constructively.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree; advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 10% for client meetings and industry events.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <p>We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.</p> <hr> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.</p> <p> </p> <p>Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.</p> <p> </p> <p>Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p><strong>Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director/Senior Director, Molecular Discovery
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.</p> <p>This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.</li> <li>Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.</li> <li>Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.</li> <li>Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.</li> <li>Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Define and enforce the quality standards, assay cascades, and decision criteria that govern how compounds progress through the pipeline.</li> <li>Facilitate relationships with CROs and external partners for specialized studies (e.g., in vivo pharmacology, safety pharmacology, DMPK) that sit outside the automated platform.</li> <li>Provide drug discovery expertise to Lila's product team for commercial partnerships, translating platform capabilities into credible value propositions for pharma and biotech collaborators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ph.D. in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or a closely related discipline.</li> <li>12+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side with at least 5 years in a senior role closely involved in advancing compounds from hit-to-lead through candidate selection.</li> <li>Demonstrated involvement in programs that delivered clinical candidates, with enough proximity to compound progression decisions to own them whether from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side.</li> <li>Deep fluency in medicinal chemistry principles, you may not have practiced bench medchem, but you understand SAR, synthetic tractability, and the multiparameter tradeoffs at the core of lead optimization (potency, selectivity, ADMET, PK, safety) well enough to guide them or define systematic decision frameworks for them.</li> <li>Operational mindset, experience running discovery programs with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability structures, and a comfort level with managing throughput and efficiency alongside scientific quality.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ADMET, DMPK, and the data packages required to advance a candidate to IND-enabling studies.</li> <li>Fluency with AI/ML-driven molecular design approaches (generative chemistry, molecular property prediction, free energy methods, active learning) and the practical judgment to know when computational output is actionable and when it needs experimental validation. You don’t need to build models, but you must be a credible, hands-on collaborator with the scientists who do.</li> <li>Effective communicator who can translate complex scientific and operational status into clear updates for leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with automated, high-throughput, or closed-loop discovery environments (e.g., self-driving labs, robotic synthesis and screening platforms), you've seen what it takes to make these systems produce real drug discovery output, not just proof-of-concept demos.</li> <li>Experience applying computational chemistry or cheminformatics in a hands-on capacity, not just consuming model outputs, but contributing to how molecular design hypotheses are generated, scored, and prioritized.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling a discovery operation from early stage, standing up assay cascades, workflows, team structures, and vendor relationships without inheriting a mature infrastructure.</li> <li>Background across multiple therapeutic areas, giving you breadth in target biology and the flexibility to work across a diverse portfolio.</li> <li>Process-oriented thinking: you instinctively look for ways to measure, standardize, and improve how work gets done, without letting process become bureaucracy.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.</p> <p><strong>U.S. Benefits.</strong> Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.</p> <p><strong>International Benefits.</strong> Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. exciting.</p> <p><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in the German-speaking market’s largest, title: Account Executive - Majors
description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 ClickUp is hiring a Majors Account Executive to grow and expand our footprint across larger EMEA customers. This role is built for a seller who can take strong product adoption, identify real whitespace, and turn it into broader, multi-team commercial growth. This is an especially important hire now because ClickUp’s international business already matters materially, and larger customers increasingly want to consolidate scattered tools, improve execution clarity, and understand how AI can create leverage across teams. We need someone who can run strong discovery, build a credible business case, and guide more complex stakeholder groups from interest to expansion. Mission Own and grow expansion revenue across major EMEA accounts by identifying whitespace, building business cases, and positioning ClickUp as the platform that helps larger teams work with more clarity, speed, and operational leverage. Key outcomes and responsibilities Own expansion opportunities across major accounts in your region, with a core focus on larger organisations in the roughly 1,000–2,500 employee range. Consistently exceed pipeline and sales targets by converting account signals, free trials, marketing-qualified leads, demo requests, and product adoption into qualified commercial opportunities. Run structured discovery that uncovers workflow pain, stakeholder priorities, buying friction, and the business case for broader ClickUp adoption. Deliver compelling presentations and demos that connect ClickUp’s platform value to customer priorities, cross-functional workflows, and executive-level outcomes. Build and manage multithreaded deal plans across end users, managers, executives, procurement, and other decision-makers. Partner closely with Growth, Marketing, and adjacent GTM teams to improve lead quality, regional account coverage, and conversion. Maintain strong process discipline across forecasting, pipeline inspection, next steps, CRM hygiene, and follow-through. Identify recurring patterns across segments, objections, and account behavior to help sharpen the majors expansion motion in EMEA. Support more formal buying motions when needed, including RFIs / RFQs and procurement-heavy evaluations. Required qualifications Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS sales with clear ownership of full-cycle deals, account growth, or expansion motions. Track record of exceeding quota and managing a disciplined pipeline in commercial, strategic, or larger-account environments. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort communicating with both practitioners and executive stakeholders. description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Our team is responsible for driving sustainable and scalable customer acquisition, engagement, and retention—ensuring our banking solutions reach and resonate with the right SMEs at the right time. Growth is both a science and an art. We blend commercial strategy with deep customer understanding, leveraging data to uncover new opportunities while ensuring every touchpoint aligns with Allica’s mission to empower established SMEs with the banking they deserve. Role Description The Growth Manager will play a key role in driving effective and sustainable growth across Allica's BRA customer journey — from onboarding through account activation and into deeper, embedded product usage. This role focuses on understanding customer behaviour end-to-end, identifying where customers stall or disengage, and building the strategies and capabilities needed to move them forward. Using a data-driven approach, the Growth Manager will lead the design and delivery of initiatives that improve activation, engagement, and long-term customer value — often working with limited precedent and translating diagnosis into tools, frameworks, and ways of working that the wider business relies on. They will build alignment across marketing, product, sales, RM, and data teams, ensuring growth strategy is coherently applied across the customer journey. Principal Accountabilities Customer Behaviour & Cohort Analysis: Lead analysis of customer behaviour, lifecycle stages, and cohorts to identify key drivers of activation, engagement, and product usage, delving into complex problems to reach root-cause understanding rather than surface patterns. Data-Driven Insights & Strategic Recommendations: Own the growth and engagement metrics that matter most for the customer journey, translating insight into strategy that shapes how the team and wider business operate. Experimentation & Optimisation: Manage a robust experimentation pipeline, designing, prioritising, and overseeing tests across initiatives to ensure impactful, evidence-based decisions rather than one-off analysis. Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Build alignment across departments; marketing, product, sales, RM, and data, managing differing stakeholder expectations to keep initiatives progressing. Framework & Capability Building: Take diagnosed problems through to operational reality, building the tools, scoring frameworks, and processes that other teams adopt and rely on. Leadership & Ownership: Manage multiple objectives concurrently, ensuring accountability for outcomes even where the path forward isn't well precedented. Communication: Design and deliver insightful, visually compelling presentations that influence decision-making and align stakeholders on growth strategy Personal attributes & Experience Experience working in hypothesis-led, problem-solving environments (e.g. high-growth start-ups, consulting or similar) is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex, ambiguous problems using structured thinking. Proven experience conducting complex data and performance analysis, ideally using SQL to work with large datasets. Ability to translate customer and operational insights into clear, actionable changes across products, processes, or messaging. Comfortable working with technical systems and integrations (e.g. CRM, analytics tools, automation platforms) to improve efficiency and scale. High bar for quality while maintaining pace, particularly on work with limited precedent. Strong stakeholder management skills, able to influence and align teams with different priorities through clear, evidence-led recommendations. Bias towards ownership and execution — able to independently drive work forward, frame problems, and recommend solutions with limited direction Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. This role sits within the cyber safety pillar, working primarily on Avast and its freemium ecosystem, while staying closely connected to the wider design community across Gen's brands. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead (Energy & Industrials) on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research for E&I you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Energy & Industrials sector, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within Energy & Industrials (E&I)</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Energy & Industrials (E&I) with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> <li>You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.</li> <li>You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.</li> <li>You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.</li> </ul> description: <p><strong>Soho, London <br></strong><strong><em>Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs</em><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a brilliant and motivated Junior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Analytics team. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.</p> <p><em>We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting and you might not feel you tick every box. You will actively use ground-truth experimental data (e.g., GeoX tests, attribution model). </li> <li>Budget Scenario Planning: Translate model outputs into actionable simulation tools and optimization scenarios. You will help stakeholders answer critical "what-if" questions regarding budget reallocations and product splits. </li> <li>User Data & Performance Analytics: Use SQL to deep-dive into first-party user data and tracking key KPIs.</li> <li>Data Quality & Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate with our Data Engineering teams to automate data ingestion pipelines, ensuring high-quality, model-ready inputs from ad-platforms, attribution tools, and internal databases. </li> <li>Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex econometric, Bayesian, or machine learning concepts into clear, commercial, and highly visual recommendations for marketing team leads and senior leadership. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience or a degree in a highly quantitative field (e.g., Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or Engineering).</li> <li>Python (or R) proficiency: Solid programming foundations for data manipulation (pandas, numpy), statistical modeling, and machine learning (we primarily use Python). </li> <li>Strong SQL skills: Comfortable writing efficient, structured queries to extract and aggregate massive datasets from relational databases. </li> <li>MMM Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in modern open-source MMM libraries (e.g., Meta's Robyn, Google's Meridian, or PyMC/Bayesian workflows). </li> <li>Solid foundation in econometrics, time-series analysis, and regression modeling (OLS, Ridge/Lasso, Bayesian regression). </li> <li>Good understanding of testing and experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, GeoX testing, hypothesis testing, and statistics like MDE and bias analysis). </li> <li> A keen interest in marketing dynamics (customer acquisition, CAC, CPA, ROI, and media attribution).</li> <li>We welcome applications from recent graduates and early career professionals, including candidates who have gained initial experience in an agency or client side environment, ideally with exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), marketing effectiveness, or related marketing analytics. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What can we offer? </strong></p> <ul> description: <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Customer Success team sits within DoorDash’s In-Store business and serves as a strategic partner to hospitality operators across the UK. empathy with accountability</li> <li>Use data and operational insights to drive strategic recommendations</li> <li>Create urgency around growth opportunities and operational improvements</li> <li>Act as strategic partners to hospitality operators</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About DoorDash</strong></p> <p>At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. </p> <p>DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What we expect from you</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Startdate</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Flexible </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p> </p></div><p><em><span data-contrast="none">By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. </span></em><a href="https://www.geniussports.com/about-us/"><em><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Learn more at geniussports.com.</span></span></em></a><span data-contrast="none"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><br>The Role</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will join one of our established high-performing teams within the Betting division, as we invest in our core and future Betting products. You will be focusing on the delivery of technical and product-focused initiatives, to expand and scale up our industry's leading Sportsbook and Risk Management products.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">One example is our Advanced Risk team, who were set up to challenge conventional wisdom about risk management for sports betting operators. Using new measures of liability that take account of correlations between different markets on an event, and by monitoring betting patterns from the moment an event is opened for betting, we apply margins asymmetrically in a way that helps operators to make higher profit margins, reduce volatility and improve customer experience with greater uptime and fewer rejected bets. Our software provides customers with a new level of flexibility over the way they manage their Sportsbooks to meet their financial objectives. Smart algorithms allow decisions about bets to be taken quickly at scale while enabling close control when desired, reminiscent of earlier days of sports betting.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><br></span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How will you work?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join a specially formed, highly skilled team delivering an innovative & intelligent product! Forming part of a multi-disciplinary Agile team of Software Engineers, Data Scientists, QA Engineers and a Product Manager, you will look to work closely to the fundamental principles of continuous delivery and empowered, high-performing teams.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We operate in a squad model to allow focus on the business top priorities, allowing exposure across multiple products while still maintaining strong ownership of your team’s domain.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">If you are looking to tackle hard problems with smart solutions, collaborate with astute engineers and deliver high calibre code with an autonomous & performance focused approach that supports success, delivery & quality, then this is for you.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Senior Software Engineer 1 (SR1)  you and your team will build highly distributed, real-time, dynamically scaling systems using modern CI/CD pipelines & cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for innovating, architecting, delivering & maintaining an industry-revolutionising product. You will lead execution of multi-sprint features or systems with measurable business impact.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We will lean on your technical expertise and your pragmatic approach to problem solving; working in a team that prioritises the principles of Agile delivery and continuous improvement. You will have a Data-driven, evidence-based mentality, comfortable with the principles of continuous experimentation and validation. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"> <br></span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills do you have?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="·" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="1" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"·","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">You will have expert level knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (C#, Java, JS, Kotlin, Python, PHP, Golang, C++) </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="·" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="1" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"·","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="2" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Flexibility to work on all areas of the service stack, front-end, back-end, infrastructure etc.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="·" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="1" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"·","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="3" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">You will have a strong understanding of the principles of good software design. title: Engineering Director
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for an ambitious and talented Director of Engineering to join Omnea, the UK's #1 Startup in 2026 , as a senior member of our Engineering leadership team. You'll report directly to our CTO, Dhruv Kumar , who joined us from Voy and has scaled engineering organizations at Hopin, Charlotte Tilbury, and THG. This is a manager-of-managers role. You'll lead a group of Engineering Managers and Team Leads: 25-50 engineers across several teams. You'll own the outcomes, org design, and technical direction of a significant slice of the product. As we grow from tens to hundreds of enterprise customers and through 10x revenue growth in the next 2-3 years, you'll play a crucial role in building the best Engineering function in its category. You'll operate with high autonomy, partnering with the CTO, Product leadership, and your peers across R&D to turn strategy into shipped software. What you’ll do Build and lead the leaders: Hire, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and Team Leads. Your primary output is their effectiveness, not your own. Set and hold a high performance bar across the group, including the harder calls on performance and leveling. Own org design for your area: how teams are shaped, sized, and split as the product and company grow. Build the bench: identify and grow the next generation of engineering leaders at Omnea. Own the headcount plan for your group, from business case through to hiring. Own delivery at group scale: Be accountable for the outcomes of several teams at once, not the output of any one of them. Create the operating rhythm (planning, prioritization, and reporting) that keeps a multi-team group moving quickly and predictably. Unblock at the seams: the cross-team dependencies, ambiguous ownership, and architectural decisions that no single team can resolve. Ensure robust monitoring, observability, and incident response across your area. Shape technical and product strategy: Partner with the CTO and Product leadership to define and execute the technical roadmap for your domain. Make the build/buy, architecture, and technical investment calls that shape the platform for years, and bring the rest of R&D with you. Balance technical debt, feature development, and reliability, and be able to defend those trade-offs to the exec team. Ensure customer feedback drives technical priorities, including direct time with enterprise customers. Teams and products you might end up working on: Accounting and Goods Receipting – ensuring procurement and finance teams have the right information and tools to operate accurately, automatically, and at scale. Insights and Reporting – deep, complex custom visualizations bringing together AI and data to surface meaningful insights and context across the platform. Sourcing – building the tools that find the right suppliers, shape the right deals, and make sure the best option is already in play before a request is even created. Workflow Orchestration – the configurable backbone of our systems that accurately model company operations, underpinning a single source of truth. And many more areas we’re actively starting or expanding upon! About You Leadership Experience: You have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership. You have 2+ years managing managers, having hired, coached, and where necessary, performance-managed Engineering Managers or Team Leads. You've led a group of 25-50 engineers across multiple teams and owned the org design for it. You've demonstrated success in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, particularly in rapid-growth periods. Ideally, you've done this at more than one company, including at least one successful Series A+ B2B SaaS company. Technical Excellence: Strong technical background with hands-on experience in modern web technologies. Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture (preferably AWS), and scalability challenges. Experience with our stack (TypeScript, React, AWS Serverless) is a plus, but not required. Track Record of Impact: Strong track record of delivering complex, multi-team programs that moved company outcomes: product adoption, revenue, and customer retention. Proven history of improving team velocity and quality at the group level, not just within a single team. Experience scaling an engineering organization through a period of rapid growth and adapting the structure as it grew. Experience implementing engineering processes that scale effectively at pace. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating their needs into technical solutions. Leadership Style: You're data-driven but know when to trust intuition. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and owning them when they don't land. You excel at influence without authority, across Product, Design, GTM, and the exec team. You have a track record of growing and developing engineering leaders, as well as engineers at all levels (Senior, Staff, Principal). You stay close enough to the technology to be credible with senior engineers without taking the work off them. Nice to haves that really stand out to us: Track record of successful product launches in B2B SaaS. Experience with procurement/finance systems. History of contributions to engineering communities. You can learn more about Engineering at Omnea and our hiring process via our R&D Candidate Hub here . At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software. As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build. You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster. title: Associate Product Manager
description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role We're looking for someone early in their career who wants to learn how fintech products are actually built. We are not necessarily looking for a traditional product manager, who is focused on managing roadmaps or writing tickets. Instead, we are looking for a builder . Someone who does not take things at face value, who asks why things work the way they do and who enjoys challenging assumptions before jumping to solutions. You will work closely with the Cards team to break down problems, test ideas and improve the product and business quickly. Many of the best improvements will come from questioning how things currently work and finding simpler or faster ways to do them. If you are curious about fintech, lending and technology and want to see how a real product is built and scaled, this role gives you that exposure. What you'll be doing This role spans a wide range of work across the UK Cards product . Broadly, the work falls into two areas. 1. Running fast experiments Many valuable improvements do not require engineering builds. We want someone who enjoys questioning how things work today and running quick experiments to test better approaches. Examples include: Testing different messaging, offers or incentives to increase engagement Testing new acquisition features Running manual experiments to validate ideas before committing engineering 2. Supporting product, tooling and AI initiatives You will also support the team in improving how we operate and scale. Examples include: Maintaining and improving how the team uses AI tools (Claude, Cursor etc) Supporting with building out AI customer support tools Helping Finance and Capital Markets teams A key part of the role is challenging how things are done today and helping the team find simpler, faster or better ways to operate. Who this role is for This role is designed for someone who wants to build things and learn quickly. Typical profile 1 - 3 years of experience in strategy, analytics, consulting or product Likely your second job rather than a graduate role Strong interest in technology, fintech and startups Curious about AI and new tools Interested in building products or starting companies in the future You should be someone who Thinks from first principles rather than accepting how things currently work Asks good questions and challenges assumptions Enjoys solving messy problems Works well with data and numbers Likes testing ideas quickly Is comfortable working in fast moving environments - we will give you direction and ownership but expect you to drive your agenda Takes ownership and gets things done Why this role is interesting You will get exposure to How consumer lending and credit cards work How fintech products are built and scaled Experimentation and growth AI tooling and automation inside a real product team The operational side of running a fintech company You will work closely with senior members of the Cards team and have the opportunity to own meaningful projects early in your career. Interview process A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match. A 15-minute cognitive assessment. An interview with the Hiring Manager, covering your experience and how you approach the work. A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with. A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation. Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. title: Director, PMO
description: Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. Director, PMO As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Senior Project Manager for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams. PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets. What You Will Do: Manage end-to-end project delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software engagements, from kickoff through go-live and handover. Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run. Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards. Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Partner with the VP of CS and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures. Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start. Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems. Who You Are: 5+ years of experience across Customer Success, Professional Services, or PMO, with deep experience driving complex software implementations, delivery excellence, or PMO strategy. Direct experience managing enterprise software projects or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex projects succeed or fail. Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework. Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers. Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar). Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential. Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred). What We Offer: This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market. Based in Europe, you will be a key part of our strategic growth in this market and drive the development of a self sustained business. Work on technology that matters. Our physics-enabled digital twins are actively protecting global energy grids from increasingly common weather events and structural failure, meaning your operational excellence directly translates to a more resilient world. You will have the strategic autonomy to influence global operations, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission. #LI-NT1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view. We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same. At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary. What you'll be doing Ship features end to end : Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence. title: Senior IT Technician
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the role This is a senior, hands-on role in our IT team. In this role, you will play a key part in shifting us from AI as a productivity tool to AI as a core part of how our marketing team operates to hit its outcomes. You will lead the workstreams and build agents to transform how we produce content at scale, while supporting the adoption of AI applications more broadly across the business. Throughout, you'll unlock new AI capabilities and the systems integrations that make them work within the guardrails of a regulated, financial-services environment.</p> <p>This is a role for a first-principles and systems thinker: someone who can break a complex problem down to its fundamentals, design how the pieces fit together, and build. You'll be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, and you'll be excellent at navigating a complex, stakeholder-heavy environment to get things done.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Martech & AI and sits within the Martech team, part of the Growth Collective. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be involved in:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Programme management:</strong> Leading our content scaling programme including translating goals into sequenced, actionable work, driving delivery, and coordinating owners and stakeholders across a complex environment.</p> <p><strong>Building AI agents:</strong> Designing and building AI agents (using tools like Claude) to transform how we produce and scale content. This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. This means driving a rigorous selection process from requirements through vendor evaluation to a clear, well-justified recommendation.</p> <p><strong>AI adoption across the business:</strong> Championing the adoption of AI-driven solutions beyond the programme, including helping other teams understand and apply AI, and sharing what works.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building and applying AI for teams. You've led cross-functional programmes or workstreams end to end, sequencing the work, managing dependencies and risk, keeping stakeholders aligned, and driving delivery to a successful outcome (including picking up work already in flight).</li> <li>You're a first-principles and systems thinker who can break down a complex, ambiguous problem, design how the parts fit together, and build a solution.</li> <li>You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and in complex, stakeholder-heavy environments, working with individuals at all levels to get things done.</li> <li>You have a working understanding of marketing and how content and creative are produced. You know what "good" needs to look like and how to build the right guardrails around it.</li> <li>You bring martech literacy and can run a rigorous tooling selection process. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box?
